title: Retarget a NuGet client-library host
goal: Choose a compatible runtime and actual package assets for a utility directly referencing NuGet client libraries, without retargeting ordinary package-consuming applications.

selectionNotes: NuGet client hosts are separate from ordinary package-consuming application TFMs.
Current net10.0 assets also have a verified conditional .NET 10 host route; no Framework route is advertised.

runtime.reason: Runtime that executes this client-library host; distinct from the frameworks of inspected or ordinarily consumed packages.

prerequisites: Inspect effective SDK, target framework, shared build/package files, imports and package source policy before applying this recipe.
Initial restore requires the sample-local public dotnet-tools feed for NuGet.* and nuget.org for other dependencies, or a populated authorized cache.
